findings.summary: The declared evidence runner cannot execute evaluator commands on Claude or Gemini.
No evaluation-lane role can retain the raw evidence required by the pass condition.
The harness-effect command is prose and no comparable task corpus, metric computation, or telemetry writer exists.
Main state stores failure signals at the top level while the checker reads main_state.improve.
All six role contracts reuse the same generic input, output, and rules body.
Handoff paths have no producer, consumer, freshness, provenance, or manifest schema.
The normal path serializes four roles and declares no read-only or small-change short circuit.
Existing reader-facing Change Reports are English despite report_language ko.

checks_not_run: Native Claude and Gemini end-to-end evidence-runner execution
Windows symlink escape checks requiring SeCreateSymbolicLinkPrivilege
